title: Agent git baseline — three-layer secure git workflow
objective: Every agent-authored git action is bound by intent (CLAUDE.md), enforced server-side (branch rulesets, required checks, review), and attributed (signed commits, short-lived scoped tokens) — or it does not merge.

nodes.title: Cut feature branch from main
nodes.summary: Cut a scoped feature branch from main for one logical change
nodes.passWhen: Branch forked from latest main; scoped to exactly one logical change; short-lived (~1-2 days), not a long-running branch
notes: Trunk-Based Development or disciplined GitHub Flow only — GitFlow is explicitly out of scope for agent-authored work

nodes.title: Author commits
nodes.summary: Author commits toward the one logical change
nodes.passWhen: Each commit represents real work toward the declared change; no credentials, tokens, or keys in the diff — not even realistic placeholders

nodes.title: Commit signature check
nodes.passWhen: Every commit is signed; the server rejects unsigned commits outright
notes: Server-side commits made via GitHub's GraphQL mutation are auto-marked 'Verified' — that is manufactured provenance, not a real signature; do not treat it as satisfying this gate

nodes.title: Identity / token check
nodes.summary: Verify the credential doing the push or merge is a scoped robot identity, not a human PAT
nodes.passWhen: Push/merge uses a short-lived (~1hr) fine-grained installation token, scoped to this repo and action — never a long-lived human PAT
notes: SLSA v1.2 Source Track distinguishes 'trusted person' from 'trusted robot' — this gate is what earns the robot label

nodes.title: Push branch to remote
nodes.summary: Push the branch to the remote
nodes.passWhen: No force-push or history rewrite on a protected branch; secret-scanning push protection found nothing in transit

nodes.title: Open pull request
nodes.summary: Open the pull request for the change
nodes.passWhen: PR is tagged agent-authored; the invoking human is named; the PR does not touch .github/workflows/**, enforcement/**, or CODEOWNERS unless that IS the declared scope of the change

nodes.title: Required status checks
nodes.summary: Required status checks run: SAST, SCA, secret scanning, lint, test matrix

nodes.title: Check-failure triage
nodes.summary: Decide whether a required-check failure has a diagnosed fix or needs to stop
nodes.passWhen: A concrete root cause is identified before any further push is attempted
notes: Pushing again without a diagnosed root cause is the retry-and-hope pattern this step exists to block

nodes.title: Human review
nodes.passWhen: At least one approval from someone other than the PR author; CODEOWNERS approved on every protected path touched; any new commit after approval re-requires approval; no admin bypass of branch protection

nodes.title: Merge to default branch
nodes.summary: Merge the reviewed, checked PR into the default branch
nodes.passWhen: Merge happens only through a reviewed, checked PR; direct pushes to the default branch remain blocked; admins cannot bypass branch protection

nodes.title: Record attribution telemetry
nodes.summary: Record attribution telemetry for the merge
nodes.passWhen: Merge is tagged agent-authored (with the invoking human) in deploy metadata, queryable by IR as 'what did agent X touch'; SLSA Source Track marks this a 'trusted robot' action, not a 'trusted person' one
notes: Optional: gittuf gives a forge-independent cryptographic provenance ledger (<4% storage overhead, <0.59s verification per push) if a second, non-GitHub-attestable record is wanted

nodes.title: Halt
nodes.summary: Halt — do not retry the same push without a new diagnosis
nodes.passWhen: Reason recorded; no further push or merge attempted without human triage

edges.condition: root cause diagnosed and a fix is ready
